Perfect. After **1...Qxf2+ 2.Kxf2**, Black has won White's queen (9 points) and material is now vastly in Black's favor. The key insight is that **White's queen on f2 was pinned** to the king, so Black could safely capture it with check.

**Best move:** Qxf2+

**Main line:** Qxf2+ Kxf2 (forced; 1.Kh1 is similar) Bxc4 (winning material advantage with extra queen)

**Motif:** pin

**Coaching Note (80 words):**
Look for pieces that are pinned—defending their own king. Here, White's queen on f2 is pinned to the king on g1 by your queen. This means it can't move away or recapture safely. Your queen on e3 can simply capture it with check! After the king recaptures, you've won a full queen (worth 9 points) while losing your own queen only. Always scan for pinned pieces; capturing a pinned defender is one of the most powerful tactics.
